purpose: Bind producer-built R70 Heuristic and TinyNN into dev8 and one holdout8 comparison without recompilation
primary_candidate: TinyNN model_v2 frozen before formal dev8; no holdout selection
control: Heuristic with identical causal observer/pool/features/tie handling/emission, base13 score and zero residual
method_requirements: formal binary uses unchanged official engine and timer, no diagnostic/trace mode
binary path is in actual Linux HOME persistent storage and remains accessible in a later WSL call
source dependencies include policy.hpp, shared_pool.hpp and the relevant scorer header
model weights are embedded; inference does not load model.json or external weights
Heuristic and TinyNN use the same candidate pool and causal feature contract
validation_requirements: dev_cases_checked covers all eight frozen dev input identities
score/feature/action parity reports bind the actually provided source and formal binary identities or explain diagnostic-to-formal equivalence
validation timings are not reused as formal D measurements
feature_version equals r70-causal32-v2-sequential-sums and model identity equals model_v2; v1 parity cannot certify v2
execution: Producer exports this manifest; tester verifies source/dependency hashes locally, then verifies binaries in Linux only after Root release. No recompilation of the four baseline binaries or these two producer binaries.
